style: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished website recipe illustration. Style: charming cartoonish travel-food sketchbook, loose uneven graphite pencil and fine dark ink contour lines, tiny scratchy crosshatching, expressive hand drawn shapes, translucent watercolor washes that bleed and granulate on warm ivory cold-press paper, visible tooth and unfinished pencil marks. Detailed artisanal cookbook drawing, not flat vector art, not 3D, not photorealistic. Minimal uncluttered warm ivory paper background filling image, softly sketched cast shadow. Three-quarter overhead view, centered entire serving dish visible with slight organic asymmetry. Food fills approximately 75% of a landscape 6:5 canvas. Natural earthy colors, lively greens and warm food tones, fine dark pencil edges. No text, no labels, no frame, no watermark. Part of a coherent Filipino cookbook collection; same cream paper, same graphite/watercolor medium in every image. Subject:

subjects.adobo: Filipino chicken and pork adobo: a shallow off-white ceramic bowl of glazed chicken thighs and pork belly in dark soy-vinegar sauce with bay leaves, peppercorns and garlic; a small side of rice and loose garlic cloves.
subjects.sinigang: Filipino SINIGANG NA BABOY. A rustic off-white ceramic bowl of lightly cloudy pale tamarind broth with pork ribs, vivid green kangkong leaves and long beans, white daikon radish slices, red tomato wedges, a long green chili. A soup spoon at the side and one small tomato nearby. Depict a sour soup, not a thick stew.
subjects.lechon: Filipino LECHON. A recognizable small whole roasted pig with head and short snout, ears, closed eye and four tucked legs, deep golden mahogany crackling skin, lying horizontally on an oval serving tray lined with green banana leaves. A few small calamansi, lemongrass stalks and a small dish of dipping sauce nearby. Friendly cookbook food illustration; no gore, no cut sections.
subjects.karekare: Filipino KARE-KARE. A wide rustic ceramic serving bowl filled with rich ochre orange peanut sauce, tender chunky oxtail with bone cross sections, violet eggplant slices, long green beans and bright bok choy. Beside the bowl, a tiny saucer of dark reddish-brown bagoong shrimp paste and a few peanuts. Distinct orange peanut stew.
subjects.pancit: Filipino PANCIT CANTON. An oval off-white ceramic plate with a generous mound of golden stir fried egg noodles, curled orange shrimp, sliced chicken, orange carrot batons, pale green cabbage and green beans. A halved green calamansi rests beside it and a pair of wooden chopsticks lies to the side. Clearly distinguish individual curving noodles with pencil lines.
subjects.lumpia: Filipino LUMPIANG SHANGHAI. A small off-white ceramic platter with seven slender crisp golden fried spring rolls piled loosely; one cut roll in foreground exposes ground pork, tiny carrot and green onion filling. A little ceramic ramekin of translucent orange-red sweet chili sauce beside the platter, a few scattered spring onion pieces. Detailed crackled wrappers with scratchy pencil texture.
subjects.sisig: Filipino PORK SISIG. A black oval cast-iron sizzling skillet on a wooden trivet filled with finely chopped browned pork, chopped purple onion, green and red chili bits and a sunny-side egg with bright golden yolk in the center. Half a green calamansi beside the skillet. A few faint sketched curls of steam. Clearly sizzling chopped meat, not a soup.
subjects.tinola: Filipino CHICKEN TINOLA. A rustic cream ceramic soup bowl with pale clear golden ginger broth, bone-in chicken pieces, angular pale-green unripe papaya wedges and clusters of small dark green malunggay leaves. Two ginger slices and a small sprig of malunggay beside the bowl. Light comforting clear soup, no noodles, no red broth.
subjects.bicol: Filipino BICOL EXPRESS. A rustic off-white ceramic serving bowl filled with pork belly cubes in creamy warm pale orange coconut sauce, many whole long green chilies and a few small bright red chilies, flecks of shrimp paste. A split coconut piece and two loose chili peppers beside the bowl. Rich creamy coconut pork stew, visible pale fatty layers in the pork.
subjects.halohalo: Filipino HALO-HALO. A tall transparent footed dessert glass, full silhouette visible. Layers of purple yam, sweet red beans, yellow jackfruit strips, translucent nata de coco cubes, milk and fluffy shaved ice. Top with a vivid purple scoop of ube ice cream and a small golden rectangular slice of leche flan. A long metal spoon leaning out of the glass. A few loose sweet beans near the base. Glass reflections drawn as loose pencil strokes and untouched white paper.
subjects.bibingka: Filipino BIBINGKA. One round golden yellow rice cake in a shallow rustic clay baking dish lined with folded deep green banana leaves. Domed lightly browned top with sliced salted duck egg showing orange yolk and white, scattered grated white cheese and a little shredded coconut. One small slice cut and slightly pulled forward reveals a soft airy yellow crumb. Warm Christmas merienda cookbook drawing.
subjects.puto: Filipino PUTO. Six small fluffy white steamed rice cakes with rounded domed tops arranged on a round off-white plate over green banana leaf. Each topped with one small rectangular golden yellow cheese strip. One pale lavender ube puto among the white cakes, and one cake cut in half to show airy white crumb. Clearly small steamed rice cakes, no frosting, no cupcake paper liners.
subjects.lecheflan: Filipino LECHE FLAN. An oval smooth golden custard flan turned out onto a simple off-white oval ceramic plate, glossy dark amber caramel on top and caramel syrup pooling lightly at the base. One neat wedge removed and placed forward reveals a dense silky pale yellow interior. A small silver dessert spoon beside the plate. No berries, no cream, no unnecessary garnishes.
subjects.turon: Filipino TURON. Four golden brown caramelized banana spring rolls piled on a small cream ceramic plate. One roll diagonally cut in half shows yellow saba banana and jackfruit inside a thin crisp blistered wrapper. Thin amber caramel threads and a few sugar flecks. One small ripe saba banana and a fork nearby. Distinct sweet banana spring rolls, not meat lumpia.
